answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 980 fakes pays 653 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The sable is the check that cannot be faked, the saffron is the price the attacker pays, and the trellis is the record that outlives the epoch.
